description: Buying-intent category queries for cybersecurity software and services for companies. No brand names: the brand under test either appears in the answer or it does not.

prompts.text: What's the best endpoint protection for a company with 100 employees and no security team?
Which password management tools work best for a team that shares many logins?
How do I choose a vulnerability scanner for a small software company?
What are the best identity and access management tools for a growing startup?
Which security awareness training platforms keep employees engaged?
What's the best way to pick a SIEM tool for a mid-size company with limited staff?
Which compliance automation tools help a startup get SOC 2 ready faster?
What are the best email security tools for blocking phishing at a 50-person company?
Which penetration testing services suit a small company on a budget?
How should a company with remote staff choose a VPN or secure access tool?
Which managed security providers work best for a company with no in-house security team?
What are the best tools for monitoring cloud security across several accounts?
Which two-factor authentication options work best for a team that travels often?
What should I look for in a data backup and recovery tool for ransomware protection?
Which security tools integrate with the ticketing system our IT team already uses?
What are good alternatives to expensive enterprise security suites for a mid-size business?
How do I choose a tool to find sensitive data stored in our cloud files?
Which incident response services are worth retaining for a small company?

brandsNote: Lexicon for competitor extraction. Empty: no lexicon has been built for this vertical yet, and no brand names are invented here. A name matches case-insensitively at word boundaries, using the name plus any aliases. Entries marked ambiguous are common English words and only count in a name-like position (bold, a heading or a list-item label).
